CityScale Decarbonization

Municipal climate plans need building-sector pathways that can be discussed with planning, facilities, and energy partners.

Representative case study · not presented as named client work

Challenge

City-scale targets are easy to state and hard to connect to the timing of envelope upgrades, electrification, and grid change.

Approach

Use urban building energy modeling and scenario narratives to make trade-offs visible without implying a single official forecast.

Expected value

Expected value is a shared language for policy and investment conversations. City-wide percentage reductions are not claimed here.

Methods

  • Urban building energy modeling
  • Scenario narratives
  • CONTENT TO CONFIRM for local stock data
